contentText: Ukraine has struck the bridge linking Russia and ⁠Crimea across the Kerch strait, limiting the flow of traffic, the peninsula's Russian-backed governor Sergei Aksyonov ⁠said on Monday. It comes after Russia struck energy and railway infrastructure across Ukraine over the weekend, in attacks President Volodymyr Zelensky said were made possible ⁠partly due to restrictions on Ukraine's use of SpaceX's Starshield service.
